shared: Changelings wear another unit's text and tribe on top of their own, borrowing from shop and board.
differ: What pays: a disguise's age, how many disguises you put on, or trading units with the shop.

takes.label: Let it ride
takes.line: Each disguise counts the turns it's been worn; you let the count climb for bigger payoffs, or unmask to cash it in.
takes.look_if: a slow build-up you cash in with one big Unmask.

takes.label: The shop wardrobe
takes.line: Each turn every Changeling may change into a new shop unit, leaving a 1-gold blank body in its slot; shops are menus.
takes.look_if: to re-dress your board from every shop, growing wide and steady.

takes.label: Trading with the shop
takes.line: Trade your units into the shop for better ones; buffs and disguises move across, and every trade pays out all game.
takes.look_if: to work the shop like a trading partner, not a store.
